data.narrative:
Cuby Technologies is a Series B-stage housing and construction company founded by Aleks Gampel and Aleh Kandrashou that has raised $23.4M to date. The comp universe for this valuation consists of two private peers—Plantd Materials and Cover—reflecting the limited public market comparables available in this sector.

This analysis applies stage-progression methodology, the most applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. The method uses total capital raised ($23.4M) as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression to subsequent funding rounds, yielding an implied valuation of $44M. This stage-based approach reflects observed patterns in venture capital mark-ups between Series B and later stages.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $38M (low) to $51M (high), with a median estimate of $44M. Key uncertainties stem from reliance on a single applicable method and limited private comparables in the housing and construction sector. The absence of public comps and restricted private peer data limit triangulation robustness. Capital efficiency metrics, revenue traction, and competitive positioning within the narrow comp set would materially refine this estimate but are not available in the current dataset. Investors should weight this range accordingly pending deeper operational diligence.
